articles.summary: AUSTIN, Texas and DURHAM, N.C., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Shattuck Labs, Inc. (“Shattuck” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: STTK), a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of potentially first-in-class monoclonal and bispecific DR3 blocking antibodies for the treatment of patients with inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases, today announced that it has granted inducement equity awards on November 10, 2026 (the “Grant Date”) to two newly-hired non-executive employees. The inducement awards consist of non-qualified stock options to purchase an aggregate of 384,000 shares of Shattuck’s common stock with an exercise price of $4.85 per share. The stock options have a maximum term of 10 years. A total of 25% of each award will vest on the first anniversary of each employee’s start date, with the remainder vesting in equal monthly installments over the subsequent 36 months.
